hooks.text: 每清完一座竞技场就选择升级或新能力，让协同效果随征服房间数不断复合放大。
hooks.excerpt: Every arena cleared is a chance to evolve. Choose upgrades, unlock new abilities, and construct synergies that compound with each room you conquer.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 安全区内六名幸存者各有与公司和生物质相关的过去，深化关系可解锁永久升级、叙事分支与深层内容。
hooks.excerpt: Between runs, retreat to the last safe pocket of the facility where six survivors have made an uneasy home. Each carries their own history with the corporation, the biomass, and you. Deepen those relationships to unlock permanent upgrades, new narrative paths, and content that changes what you find in the depths.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 推进越深，设施会调整敌人编组、生成新威胁并让建筑本身敌对；死亡留下的数据必须用于下一轮应对。
hooks.excerpt: The deeper you push, the more the facility adapts. Enemy compositions evolve. New threats emerge from the biomass. The architecture itself becomes hostile. Death is not the end — it is data. Every run teaches you something the next one will demand you apply.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 成长系统让每次尝试后都能感到变强。

excerpts.excerpt: you feel stronger after each attempt
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 自适应敌人与程序关卡持续制造紧张感。
